headline: [Exclusive] Industry Burden Increase Proposed for Protection of Policyholders of Failed Life Insurers – FSA: Jiji.com
summary: A plan is emerging to increase the industry's burden share for the Life Insurance Policyholder Protection Corporation. The FSA is considering making the government subsidy scheme permanent, ahead of a March 2027 deadline.
why: Japan's Financial Services Agency oversees life insurers, and the policyholder protection corporation compensates customers when an insurer fails, so funding changes affect industry costs.
